description: Spearheaded company-wide marketing campaigns introducing new products which boosted sales by more than 67% in just 1 year.
Ensured long-term profitability by researching and renegotiating vendor and customer contracts. Identified and eliminated loss making products and promoted profitable ones.
Single-handedly developed a large customer base for a new product range increasing sales from zero base to more than $2 million in just under 4 years.
Demonstrated strong leadership by recruiting, training and managing more than 20 employees across different locations and multiple departments.
Worked for two and half year as graduate teaching assistant, teaching organic chemistry laboratory to undergraduates.
Trained over 250 students in basic to semi-advanced theoretical and laboratory skills in organic chemistry.

matchmaking_summary: This candidate is a seasoned Business Development Leader with over seven years of experience in sales, marketing, and business development roles. With a strong background in managing cross-functional teams and negotiating contracts that ensure long-term profitability, the candidate has successfully led the transformation of a small chemical trading firm into a thriving manufacturer, national distributor, and global manufacturer's sole-trading partner. The ability to source strategic products through competitive bidding showcases a competitive edge in market development. The educational background in Organic Chemistry provides a solid foundation for analytical and data-driven decision making within business environments.
